section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1971
title: ## ALL INDIA SURVEY During the year 1971, 43,675 suicides were reported in India as against 48,428 during 1970, indicating a decrease of 9·8%. Table 6 presents the comparative incidence of suicidal deaths during the period 1964 to 1971. The incidence of suicides has been increasing from 1965 to 1970 but in 1971 it indicated a very sharp decrease. The volume of suicides per one lakh of population has also increased from 6·3 during 1965 to 8·8 during 1970, but in 1971 it decreased to 7·9. On an average more than 60·3% of the total suicides were committed by males while persons in the age-group of 18 to 30 years were more prone to commit suicides. This age-group accounted for 44·7% of the total suicides in the country during 1971. TABLE-VI
